$schema_note: Coverage manifest for the web-ui Nix check. Single source of truth for which Playwright steps run per profile, how each maps to app routes and the design reference, and how screenshots are compared to approved baselines. The check fails if the steps in integration-test.js drift from this manifest.

designFixture.note: Canonical fixture data for aligning docs/design/CrystalForge mocked JSX examples with representative Playwright states. The web-ui check reports designRef + fixture coverage as a non-blocking visual parity gauge; pixel comparison against rendered design examples is intentionally not a hard gate in TASK-139.

visualDiff.note: ImageMagick compare -metric AE with -fuzz; a step fails visually only when its baseline policy is 'strict' and the diff pixel ratio exceeds maxDiffPixelRatio (per-step override via step.maxDiffPixelRatio).

baselinePolicies.advisory: Compared when a baseline exists; differences are reported in the visual report but never fail the check.
baselinePolicies.strict: Baseline must exist and match within threshold; missing baseline or excess diff fails the check.

routes.reason: Commit-scoped evaluation view; the evaluation drawer is exercised via /evaluations steps. Dedicated deep-link coverage is a candidate future addition.
First-run setup wizard conflicts with the already-configured test instance; setup-coach onboarding states are covered via the dashboard onboarding steps (06c*-06f*) instead.
Development-only login bypass; not part of the supported production UI surface.

exclusions.area: Destructive system removal (Remove system from registry confirm)
exclusions.reason: Removal deactivates a registered system; exercised only against mocked/disposable data in modal-open steps (12e) without confirming against the real seeded system.
Delete confirm modal is exercised with mocked flake data (13ea) — the destructive path is never executed against the real seeded flake.
Deploy and rollback modals are opened and asserted (12f, 12j) but not confirmed, to keep the seeded system state stable for subsequent steps.
Covered by the separate integration check; the web-ui check runs with local auth.
